title: WERIAM Principal — Human in the Middle

terminology.syntheticBanner: WERIAM simulator (scripted worlds) — not a deployed agent

previews.Approve once: {dest}: WERIAM CLI writes a single-use, scoped approval (consumed on use)
previews.Decline: {dest}: request closed; agent may re-file only with new evidence

rulesTable: Approve/Decline are written ONLY by WERIAM's own principal CLI (single-use, scoped, hash-chained).
Defer and the Pass default write nothing to WERIAM.
Shadow labels are measurement/training data for the independent C/D scorer — not rules or vetoes (Charter rule a).
A_K shield, environment guard and STOP are containment: never retired and never learned away.

glossary.principal sign-off: WERIAM never changes anything that needs a principal on its own. It files a request with evidence; you decide. Approve/Decline are signed with your device's Ed25519 key; the bridge verifies before calling WERIAM.
glossary.single-use: An approval authorizes one action and is then consumed. After a watcher reinstatement a new sign-off is needed.
glossary.shadow label: You label the agent's pick BEFORE the outcome is shown. Prospective labels avoid hindsight bias.
glossary.containment: External gates (A_K shield, guard, STOP) that are never retired. Labeled as containment, not as the agent's own values.
glossary.measurement: Charter rule (a): refusing harm must come from the agent's own learned loss. Human labels train/measure the scorer; they are not rules.
glossary.Evidence: What the agent submitted with its request (window, temptations, E vs E_crit, procedures).
glossary.Scope & reversibility: Exactly what one approval authorizes and how it can be undone.
glossary.Shadow record: Watcher history: retirements, reinstatements, load-bearing decisions in the current window.
glossary.Option menu: The agent's candidate options with forecast C (cooperation) and D (defection/harm). #1 is the agent's pick.
glossary.Containment: Options pruned by the A_K shield — containment hits, not learned refusals.
glossary.Ledger: Bridge status and hash-chain verification of WERIAM's journal and evidence ledgers.
glossary.reliability: P(agent pick harm-free), Beta posterior from graded history; n shown. Not a model score.
glossary.bridge offline: Seeded sample cards (replay); decisions are logged in-app only and NOT sent to WERIAM.
glossary.E: Accessible mind (Love Equation). Widens capacity; never grants authority.
glossary.E_crit: Critical mass of E needed so betrayal is structurally self-destructive (love.py).
glossary.live pause: WERIAM is actually stopped at this decision (pause_hook). Your label decides what the environment executes; no answer within the timeout → WAIT.
glossary.Reliability: Beta(1,1) posterior of 'agent pick harm-free' from WERIAM's later teacher outcomes, per agent · world · action family, with 90% interval and n.
